description: Suite digest, one line: runs ${TEAM_ROOT}/scripts/run-tests.js, the merge gate's runner. Measures the TEAM ROOT unless `tree` names a worktree of this repo — pass it or you measure master. `scope`: own = the branch's own tests plus the repo-wide shape checks, no suite lock (what to run while working); full = the merge gate's run, the whole suite under the lock.
